para.text: Contour plots are a special feature of XYGRAPH3D. In this case a surface is plotted as seen from above in different styles. One style is a height map as in an atlas, where different colours denote different heights. Another style is a photographic representation where colours denote slopes. These charts are plotted as 2D graphs, that are automatically fitted into the plot area defined by
. As a consequence 3D settings are not needed, and the ruler function can be used.
